highlights: Owned backend architecture for a payment orchestration platform handling 4M+ API requests per day across payments, cross-border transfers, and loan origination, with 8+ Spring Boot microservices behind Spring Cloud Gateway.

Designed Kafka-based asynchronous notification flows with idempotent consumers and recovery handling, reducing user-facing latency in core payment journeys and preventing cascading failures under peak load.
Migrated high-volume financial search from relational queries to Elasticsearch, cutting response times by about 60 percent across transaction and customer data workflows.
Delivered layered access control with Spring Security, OAuth2, JWT, and RBAC, enforcing least-privilege access across regulated financial APIs and strengthening PCI-DSS readiness.
Led digital onboarding flows with KYC, KYB, AML, and document-verification integrations, reducing compliance-related onboarding errors by roughly 70 percent.

Built fault-tolerant regulatory file submission services with SQS-backed retries and DLQ handling, achieving 99.9 percent-plus delivery success on Central Bank submissions while mentoring 4 engineers through code reviews and TDD.
Designed external-facing REST APIs for payment gateways and loan processing systems, standardizing versioning, error contracts, and backward compatibility for smoother third-party integrations.
Helped lead the migration of a legacy loan platform into Spring Boot and Spring Cloud microservices, cutting downtime by roughly 60 percent and improving release confidence.
Partnered with frontend teams on API contract design and Swagger / OpenAPI documentation, reducing integration issues by around 25 percent and enabling parallel delivery.
Decoupled non-critical workloads from synchronous loan-processing flows, improving throughput stability under peak traffic and reducing operational bottlenecks.
Profiled production bottlenecks, introduced targeted Redis caching, and built ELK-backed observability workflows that reduced service latency and saved 10+ engineering hours per week.
Maintained 99.95 percent transaction reliability across mobile payment and money-transfer services processing 1M+ daily transactions, using retries, idempotency, and resilient integration patterns.
Engineered structured integration APIs for partner banks and payment systems, reducing onboarding timelines by about 40 percent through versioned REST contracts and standardized validation.
Improved peak payment-processing speed by around 35 percent by combining Redis caching with MongoDB-backed high-throughput storage for time-critical transaction flows.
Designed Jenkins and Docker-based CI/CD pipelines that eliminated roughly 90 percent of deployment errors and cut release time by around 40 percent.
Expanded JUnit and Mockito coverage across critical payment flows, reducing post-release defects and improving delivery confidence.
